# The Persistent Widow (Luke 18:5)

## Emotional Focus
When you keep praying even when it feels long.

## Key KJV
“Because this widow troubleth me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me.” (Luke 18:5)

## Gentle Retelling
A widow kept asking a judge for help. She didn’t give up. Jesus said God is much kinder than that judge — He hears every prayer we keep bringing to Him.

## Coloring Prompt
A gentle widow standing bravely before a judge, asking again with hope.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Keep talking to God. He loves to hear from you.”
